Package org.a2aproject.sdk.extras.opentelemetry.server

Class OpenTelemetryPushNotificationSenderDecorator

java.lang.Object
org.a2aproject.sdk.extras.opentelemetry.server.OpenTelemetryPushNotificationSenderDecorator
All Implemented Interfaces:
PushNotificationSender
@Decorator @Priority(100) public abstract class OpenTelemetryPushNotificationSenderDecorator extends Object implements PushNotificationSender
OpenTelemetry CDI Decorator for PushNotificationSender.

Creates a CLIENT span named SendPushNotification for every push notification delivery attempt, capturing the task ID, context ID, and event kind as span attributes. The span status reflects the actual delivery outcome: OK when all notifications succeed, ERROR when one or more deliveries fail or an exception is thrown.

This decorator is registered in the module's META-INF/beans.xml and is therefore active automatically when this module is on the classpath — no additional configuration is needed.

  • Method Details

    • sendNotification

      public boolean sendNotification(StreamingEventKind event, @Nullable Task taskSnapshot)
      Description copied from interface: PushNotificationSender
      Sends a push notification containing a streaming event.

      Called after the event has been persisted to TaskStore. The payload format depends on the protocol version used to register the push notification configuration.

      • v1.0 (default): The event is wrapped in a StreamResponse format (per A2A spec section 4.3.3) with the appropriate oneof field set (task, message, statusUpdate, or artifactUpdate).
      • v0.3: The payload is a v0.3 Task JSON object, using the provided taskSnapshot. Message events are skipped.

      Retrieve push notification URLs or messaging configurations from PushNotificationConfigStore using the task ID extracted from the event.

      Supported event types:
      • Task
      • Message
      • TaskStatusUpdateEvent
      • TaskArtifactUpdateEvent

      Error Handling: Return false on delivery failures (network errors, HTTP errors). Throwing is reserved for precondition violations such as a missing task ID or an unsupported event type — these signal caller bugs. Callers catch all exceptions so neither case fails the client request.

      Specified by:
      sendNotification in interface PushNotificationSender
      Parameters:
      event - the streaming event to send.
      taskSnapshot - the current state of the task after the event has been applied. Used by formatters for older protocol versions that require the full task state in notifications.
      Returns:
      true if all notifications were delivered successfully, false if one or more deliveries failed
